description: Build the PahaadPulse single-page immersive mountain & forest hotel-retreat portal EXACTLY as specified in the user instruction, as a SINGLE self-contained HTML file (inline <style> + <script>, ZERO external JS/CSS libraries), and make it the site's cinematic landing/homepage within the Next.js app. The experience: a ~3s aerial-flyover video preloader with a 0-100% counter and a floating PahaadPulse logo that docks to the header, then a canvas 'portal' (rounded-rectangle window, radius 90px) with fake-3D pointer tilt revealing CORS-enabled mountain/forest footage, travel transitions between three retreats (Pinecrest -> Cedar Vale -> Mistfall), a custom cursor, the mountain/forest palette, entrance/switch animations, and full responsive + reduced-motion handling. Then wire routing so visiting the site shows this landing first with a clear path into the existing login -> dashboard.
steps: Create frontend/public/ (does not exist yet) and author frontend/public/pahaadpulse.html as a SINGLE self-contained HTML file honoring the spec PRECISELY. Use the EXACT remote asset URLs from section 1 (FOG_FOREST=mixkit 10086-720.mp4, LAKE_FOREST=35452-720.mp4, SNOWY_PINE=3392-720.mp4, RANGE_FLYOVER=26101-720.mp4, TO_CEDARVALE=26570-720.mp4, TO_MISTFALL=51683-720.mp4, MISTFALL_STILL=pexels 167699 w=1600) — do not substitute. Build the LOGO as an inline data:image/svg+xml URI: a mountain-peak mark stroke #7fb069 with a snow/ridge accent #cfe3d4, a 'PP' monogram in #f3f7f1, and 'PAHAADPULSE' letter-spaced in #cfe3d4 beneath. All <video> tags: muted, playsinline, preload="auto", crossorigin="anonymous", no controls, no autoplay attribute.

Implement section 2 exactly: four @font-face rules ('SF Pro' 400/700, 'SF Pro Thin' 100, 'Aalto' 400) with the specified fallback stacks; :root font-family/color/background and the full PALETTE custom properties (--pp-forest #1b3b2a, --pp-moss #4e7a3f, --pp-leaf #7fb069, --pp-mist #cfe3d4, --pp-slate #243b35, --pp-stone #0c1410, --pp-amber #e5b25d).

Build the exact DOM structure of section 3 with the exact ids/classes (internal element ids keep mars/earth/venus naming so JS state keys line up; visible copy is the PahaadPulse hotel theme): .experience[data-planet=pinecrest], .backgrounds with mars/earth/venus-background <video>, #preloader + #preloader-video + .preloader-shade, #floating-logo, #preloader-count/#preloader-value, #scene-canvas, .shade, .header.chrome with nav (Stays/Explore/Retreats) + 'Book Now' .menu button, .planet-list.chrome aside (JS-filled), #portal-canvas, .portal-wrap.chrome with heading (#next-number/#next-name) + #portal button containing #portal-video + #portal-image, .planet-content.chrome with #planet-title + #facts, .transition-layer + #transition-video, .loading, .custom-cursor with orbit/dot/label.

Implement the DATA MODEL (section 4) exactly: planets array of 8 retreats; states object keyed pinecrest/earth/venus with the exact name/next/number/portal/background/image/facts values given in the spec (Pinecrest -> Cedar Vale [03], Cedar Vale -> Mistfall [02], Mistfall [06] terminal with MISTFALL_STILL image). Implement render() per spec: set data-planet, #planet-title to name.toUpperCase(), #next-name/#next-number, portal aria-label `Travel to ${next}`, build #facts as
KEY
VALUE
, build .planet-list as Name for all 8, retrigger .is-switching on re-render (remove/reflow via offsetWidth/re-add), toggle .is-visible on matching background video, show #portal-image & hide #portal-video when state has image else inverse (swap #portal-video.src when it differs).

Implement the LAYOUT CSS (section 5), PRELOADER CSS+behaviour (section 6), the PORTAL canvas mask with fake-3D (section 7), the TRAVEL transition (section 8), the CUSTOM CURSOR (section 9), ENTRANCE/SWITCH animations (section 10), RESPONSIVE media queries (section 11), and the BOOT order (section 12) all with the EXACT values, easings, keyframes, and numeric constants given. Critical details: easeInOutCubic everywhere; preloader playbackRate = Math.max(.25, duration/3) + finish() runs ONCE with safety timeout; resizeCanvas DPR cap 2 + setTransform; drawCover cover-mode screen-locked; pointer tilt targetY=(x/W-.5)*37.4, targetX=(y/H-.5)*-33, per-frame rotX += (targetX-rotX)*Math.min(1,dt*.009) with dt clamped 40ms; rounded-rect 4 corners x10 steps ~44 pts; projection focal 850; the e=0..1 expansion math; drawShade gradient; travel() guard/transition sequence with 1.3x playbackRate, 1100ms expansion animateValue, freeze final frame into #scene-canvas, commit + revealMask()/revealPlanetContent(); custom cursor lerp 0.2/frame via translate3d, is-visible/is-enter toggling.

Verify the HTML is standalone and valid: open-check structure, ensure NO external <script src>/<link rel=stylesheet>/CDN references (inline only), balanced tags, and no obvious JS syntax errors (e.g. run `node --check` on the extracted <script> contents if feasible, or lint the JS mentally against the spec). Confirm no reference to any library (no three.js/gsap/jquery/etc).

Wire the landing into the Next.js app and define the routing flow landing -> login -> dashboard. Approach: move the existing Metrics Overview page from the '/' route to '/dashboard' (relocate app/(dashboard)/page.tsx to app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx) and update lib/theme.ts navItems so the Overview entry href becomes '/dashboard' (and the Sidebar/Header active-route logic + any Link to '/' inside the dashboard still resolve correctly). Then add a new landing route at app/ (a top-level route NOT inside the (dashboard) group and NOT gated by SessionGate) that renders the self-contained experience by embedding frontend/public/pahaadpulse.html — e.g. a full-viewport <iframe src="/pahaadpulse.html"> landing page component — so visiting '/' shows the cinematic portal first. Preserve the self-contained-HTML integrity (the experience's own JS/CSS stays inline, zero external libs) even though it is served inside the Next app.

Add the clear entry affordance from landing into the product: make the 'Book Now' button (and/or the nav) in the landing experience navigate the top-level window to '/login' (e.g. parent navigation from inside the iframe via a small inline handler, or an overlay 'Enter dashboard' link on the Next landing page that is not part of the iframe's inline script if cross-frame navigation would require an external dependency — keep the HTML lib-free). Confirm /login still works and after sign-in LoginForm redirects into the dashboard. Decide and DOCUMENT the exact routing in a comment and in the task findings: '/' = immersive landing, '/login' = auth, '/dashboard' (+ all subsystem routes) = gated product.

Update LoginForm redirect + any '/'-as-dashboard assumptions if the overview moved: LoginForm.test.tsx currently asserts push('/') after login. If you move the overview to '/dashboard', update LoginForm.tsx to redirect to '/dashboard' and update that test assertion accordingly (do not delete coverage — keep asserting a successful redirect to the dashboard home). Also update SessionGate/Header/Sidebar if they special-case '/'.

Run the full gate suite: npm run lint, npx vitest run, npm run build (note the new route count — landing route added, overview moved). Fix any build/type/lint failures. Confirm the backend gate is unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/public/pahaadpulse.html exists as a single self-contained file with inline <style> and <script> and ZERO external JS/CSS library references (no CDN <script src>/<link stylesheet>), using the exact remote asset URLs and inline SVG data-URI logo from the spec.

The HTML implements the exact DOM ids/classes, the pinecrest/earth/venus data model with the exact fact strings, the preloader (playbackRate=max(.25,duration/3), 0-100 counter, finish() once with safety timeout, logo dock), the canvas portal with fake-3D tilt (targetY*37.4 / targetX*-33, focal 850, radius 90), the travel transition (1.3x, 1100ms expansion, frozen final frame, commit, mask re-open), custom cursor, entrance/switch keyframes, responsive breakpoints (900/640px), and reduced-motion handling — matching the spec's numeric values.
The JS has no syntax errors (passes node --check on the script body) and references no external library.

Routing flow is implemented and documented: '/' renders the immersive landing (self-contained experience embedded in the Next app, not SessionGate-gated), with a clear affordance leading to '/login', and the dashboard home relocated to '/dashboard' with all 16 subsystem routes still reachable and still SessionGate-gated.
LoginForm redirects into the dashboard home after sign-in and its test asserts that redirect (coverage preserved, not deleted).
npm run lint clean, npx vitest run passing (updated as needed), npm run build succeeds with the landing route present and the overview relocated; backend pytest+ruff still green.
verification: cd frontend && export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build
node --check on the extracted <script> body of frontend/public/pahaadpulse.html (confirm no JS syntax errors)

grep for external resource refs in pahaadpulse.html: confirm no '<script src' / '<link rel="stylesheet"' / cdn/unpkg/jsdelivr references (only inline style/script + the specified mixkit/pexels media + data: URI logo)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Authored frontend/public/pahaadpulse.html as a single self-contained file (inline <style> + <script>, zero external JS/CSS libraries) honoring the spec precisely, then wired it as the Next.js homepage.

FILES CREATED/MOVED:
- CREATED frontend/public/ (did not exist) and frontend/public/pahaadpulse.html (the experience).
- CREATED frontend/app/page.tsx (top-level landing route, NOT inside the (dashboard) group, NOT SessionGate-gated; renders a full-viewport fixed iframe src=/pahaadpulse.html). Routing documented in a header comment.
- MOVED frontend/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx -> frontend/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx (git mv; still inside the SessionGate+AppShell (dashboard) group). Updated its internal filter `item.href !== "/"` -> `!== "/dashboard"`.
- EDITED frontend/lib/theme.ts: navItems Metrics Overview href '/' -> '/dashboard'.
- EDITED frontend/components/auth/LoginForm.tsx: redirect router.push('/') -> router.push('/dashboard') with a routing comment.
- EDITED frontend/components/auth/LoginForm.test.tsx: assertion push('/') -> push('/dashboard') (coverage preserved, still asserts a successful redirect to the dashboard home).
- EDITED frontend/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx: brand Link href '/' -> '/dashboard'; active-route special-case '/' -> '/dashboard'.
- EDITED frontend/components/layout/Header.tsx: active-route special-case '/' -> '/dashboard'.
- The two test files that mock usePathname()=>'/' (deep-pages.test.tsx, sentinel-destination-pages.test.tsx) render page components directly, not Sidebar/Header, so the mock value is harmless and was left unchanged; all 24 vitest tests still pass.

EXACT ROUTING FLOW (also in app/page.tsx and pahaadpulse.html comments):
  '/'          = immersive PahaadPulse landing (iframe-embedded self-contained experience, public/ungated).
  '/login'     = auth. The landing 'Book Now' button and 'Stays' nav call an inline handler that navigates window.top/parent/window to '/login' (still inline, zero external libs; works both when the HTML is opened directly and when embedded in the Next iframe).
  '/dashboard' = gated Metrics Overview home + all 16 subsystem routes, still wrapped by SessionGate + AppShell. LoginForm redirects here after sign-in.

SPEC CONFORMANCE (statically verified against sections 1-12): exact remote asset URLs (FOG_FOREST 10086, LAKE_FOREST 35452, SNOWY_PINE 3392, RANGE_FLYOVER 26101, TO_CEDARVALE 26570, TO_MISTFALL 51683, MISTFALL_STILL pexels 167699 w=1600) with no substitutions; inline data:image/svg+xml logo (mountain peaks stroke #7fb069, snow accents #cfe3d4, 'PP' monogram #f3f7f1, letter-spaced PAHAADPULSE #cfe3d4); all <video> muted/playsinline/preload=auto/crossorigin=anonymous, no controls, no autoplay. Four @font-face rules + :root palette custom props exact. Exact DOM ids/classes with internal mars/earth/venus ids kept and PahaadPulse visible copy. Data model (pinecrest/earth/venus, 8-retreat sidebar, exact fact strings, terminal venus with image) and render() behaviour (data-planet, title uppercase, next-name/number, aria-label, #facts build, .planet-list build, .is-switching retrigger via offsetWidth reflow, background is-visible toggle, portal image/video swap) implemented. All CSS layout/preloader/cursor/entrance/switch/responsive(900/640)/reduced-motion values, keyframes, and easings transcribed exactly. Preloader: playbackRate=Math.max(.25,duration/3), rAF 0-100 counter into #preloader-value, finish() guarded to run once with a safety timeout, logo dock + counter removal (750ms) + settle (2000ms), startExperience() awaits media loadable -> revealMask -> intro-ready -> 850ms revealPlanetContent. Portal canvas: DPR cap 2 + setTransform, drawCover screen-locked cover, pointer tilt targetY=(x/W-.5)*37.4 / targetX=(y/H-.5)*-33 (touch skipped, zeroed on pointerleave), per-frame rotX += (targetX-rotX)*Math.min(1,dt*.009) with dt clamped 40ms, rounded-rect 4 corners x10 steps (~44 pts) with the exact corner arc ranges, projection focal 850, e=0..1 expansion math (cx/cy/baseW/baseH/scale/r/rx/ry), clip+fill #06100a+drawCover+conditional drawShade, frozen scene blit. drawShade gradient y=.52H (rgba(6,16,10,0)) -> yH (rgba(6,16,10,.88)) over bottom 48%. travel(): guard busy/terminal, next select, transition src+load+is-loading, await canplaythrough/error/1600ms, is-transitioning, playbackRate 1.3, canvasOpacity 1, 1100ms expansion animateValue, await ended (with timeout), freeze final frame into #scene-canvas, commit + is-committing + two rAFs, reset + revealMask()/100ms revealPlanetContent, 450ms drop src, full catch reset. easeInOutCubic (t<.5?4t^3:1-pow(-2t+2,3)/2) used by animateValue. Custom cursor lerp 0.2/frame via translate3d, is-visible on first move / is-enter on portal enter/leave. Boot order: pause+rewind backgrounds, resizeCanvas, render, rAF(draw), rAF(cursorLoop), runPreloader.

STATICALLY SATISFIED checklist items: palette/colors, DOM/ids/classes, data model + fact strings, numeric constants/easings/keyframes, responsive breakpoints, reduced-motion, zero external libraries, single self-contained file, CORS attributes on all media, inline SVG logo. NEEDS IN-BROWSER CONFIRMATION (no browser/display in sandbox; dev servers blocked): the actual 3s flyover preloader playback + live 0-100 counter, logo flight/dock, canvas window reveal + pointer tilt feel (~+/-18.7/16.5 deg), the two travel transitions and the terminal Mistfall still, cursor following/ring-scale/'Enter' label, and 'zero console errors' at runtime. These depend on remote CORS media + canvas/video/rAF that only render in a real browser.
